# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 49 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_049_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 49

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed [маkаріос] are the solitary ones [монахос] and the chosen [соте], for you will find the kingdom.

**2** For you have come from it, and you will return to it again."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *монахос*: solitary ones; the Thomas technical term (cf. Saying 16)
- *соте*: chosen, elect; the same verb as Saying 23 ("I will choose you")
- "You have come FROM it" — the kingdom is the origin; the solitary ones are from the kingdom
- "You will return to it again" — the return-to-origin theme; cf. Saying 18's beginning/end
- The two qualifications (solitary + chosen) are paired; they may be two aspects of one state
- No direct Synoptic parallel
